message:
You know that moment when you’ve prepared for something, and it happens just as you thought it might? Last week, we had a little power outage during a storm, and I felt a mix of smugness and relief. I had finally gathered all our go-bags and made sure our important documents were in one spot. 

As the kids played with flashlights and we lit some candles, I couldn't help but smile at our little readiness plan in action. It’s a gentle reminder that sometimes, the best way to feel secure is to simply be a bit prepared. Have you found your own ‘I told you so’ moments lately? 😊
